_doc: The toy forge.json the suites build their world from (tests/sandbox.py seed()): every integration on, gsd_patches and house_hooks true so the user-hook rows they gate (forge's GSD copies, the house rows) are in the world, codex_harness true so Codex is configured like Claude Code (the Codex hook rows and each project's .codex/config.toml are in the world; a suite that needs it off writes its own copy), a few neutral skill tables so the generators have something to apply, and nothing of anyone's machine. Same shape as examples/forge.json. The names under skill_keep are made up: toy-common is the one skill every trimmed profile keeps, and app.claude.json is the one profile that takes the gsd-* baseline by full replace. A suite that needs another table writes its own copy over this one.
